hook.text: Gandalf guides Frodo. Obi-Wan trains Luke. Athena advises Odysseus. Heroes never journey truly alone.

buildup.text: The mentor provides knowledge, tools, or confidence the hero lacks. They bridge ignorance and action.

discovery.text: The word 'mentor' comes from Homer. Mentor was Odysseus's friend who guided his son Telemachus.

twist.text: Mentors always leave or die. Dumbledore falls. Obi-Wan vanishes. The hero must eventually stand alone.

climax.text: The mentor's exit is the real gift. It forces the hero to trust themselves. Dependence must end.

punchline.text: The best teachers make themselves unnecessary.
